name: Naya
description: The verdant jungle shard of Alara where some vedalken heretics from Esper migrated.

timeline.summary: Internal strife destroys the Nacatl Empire of the Clouds as the Claws of Marisi wage guerilla war.
timeline.quote: But internal strife destroyed the empire.

citation.text: "Running Wild". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Claws of Marisi and Pride of Judges fight in the streets and the revolutionaries triumph, breaking the Coil.
timeline.quote: In the end, Marisi's revolutionaries triumphed and the Coil was broken.

citation.text: "Running Wild". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The elves expand and surpass the Nacatl as dominant race; hostility grows as Wild Nacatl move into the lowlands.
timeline.quote: The elves are expanding their territory in Naya and have surpassed the Nacatl as the dominant race on the plane.

citation.text: "Running Wild". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mayael says the reckoning of the mighty is neither subtle nor cryptic.
timeline.quote: Never subtle nor cryptic is the reckoning of the mighty.

citation.text: Where Ancients Tread (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urak freezes on hearing a manaplasm and dies after casting a ward.
timeline.quote: Urak froze when he heard it.

citation.text: Manaplasm (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A keeper watches the valley where Progenitus sleeps.
timeline.quote: He watches over the valley where Progenitus sleeps

citation.text: Keeper of Progenitus (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elves believe Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.
timeline.quote: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya, feeding on forgotten magics.

citation.text: Relic of Progenitus (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ajani is born an albino Nacatl, an outcast among his pride.
timeline.quote: Ajani was born around 4517 AR as an albino Nacatl

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tenoch steals Ajani's kill and savagely beats him.
timeline.quote: his kill was stolen by the worst of his persecutors, Tenoch

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jazal is slain in his lair and Ajani's spark ignites as he leaves Naya.
timeline.quote: Jazal was slain in his lair with his black axe

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Internal strife and the Claws of Marisi's guerrilla war destroy the Nacatl Empire of the Clouds.
timeline.quote: But internal strife destroyed the empire.

citation.text: "Naya", section "Nacatl". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Progenitus begins to awaken in the Second Stirring.
timeline.quote: Fifteen years before the Conflux , Progenitus began to awaken, tearing the vegetation from its roots and ripping off huge sections of nearby mountains in an event later known as the Second Stirring.

citation.text: "Naya", section "The Second Stirring". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Shards of Alara realigned, some vedalken migrated from Esper to Naya.
timeline.quote: some migrated to Naya after the Shards of Alara realigned

citation.text: "Vedalken", section "Alara". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani gave up creaturehood when his brother died and his spark ignited.
timeline.quote: Ajani gave up creaturehood when his brother died and his spark ignited

citation.work: An Angel's Eye View of Bant
citation.text: "An Angel's Eye View of Bant". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Oct 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ajani discovers that his brother has been killed.
timeline.quote: after Ajani discovered his brother was killed

citation.text: "Ajani: Faces of a Planeswalker". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Oct 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The elves of Naya trace their name to Cylia, the first high priest, who witnessed the breaking of the world, and are led by a succession of Anima.
timeline.quote: They call themselves the Cylian elves after the beautiful Cylia, the first elvish high priest

citation.work: The Movers and Shakers of Naya
citation.text: "The Movers and Shakers of Naya". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Marisi calls the Nacatl to revolt against the Coil; a civil war breaks the white wall and splits the race into Wild and Cloud Nacatl.
timeline.quote: A revolutionary Nacatl named Marisi called upon his fellow leonin to revolt against the strictures of the Coil, and a great civil war broke out.

citation.work: The Movers and Shakers of Naya
citation.text: "The Movers and Shakers of Naya". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: During a Festival of Marisi, Ajani Goldmane's brother Jazal is murdered.
timeline.quote: It was during a Festival of Marisi that Ajani Goldmane's brother, Jazal, was murdered.

citation.work: The Movers and Shakers of Naya
citation.text: "The Movers and Shakers of Naya". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: An elf in sunsail tents in Naya's canopy watches over the valley of Progenitus.
timeline.quote: She's up there in her sunsail tents in Naya's canopy, watching over the valley of Progenitus

citation.text: "Topic Explosion". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Nov 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: In Mayael's vision, Progenitus unleashes five storms to consume creation.
timeline.quote: Progenitus had become displeased with creation and unleashed five storms to consume it

citation.text: "The Soul of the World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Cylia begs Progenitus for mercy and he blinds her.
timeline.quote: Furious at her impudence, Progenitus blinded the young girl

citation.text: "The Soul of the World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Cylia stabs Progenitus' mystical connection with a poisoned dagger, forcing him into a five-headed hydra form, wounded and dormant.
timeline.quote: With that one blow, Progenitus' divine essence scattered and his earthly body formed: a five-headed hydra.

citation.text: "The Soul of the World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Conflux merges the shards and Bant castles and Jund tar pits intrude on Naya; Mayael is powerless to stop it.
timeline.quote: By the time Bant castles and Jund tar pits intruded in her verdant paradise, Mayael was powerless to stop it.

citation.text: "The Soul of the World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Mayael rallies her army of elves and gargantuans to hold borders that no longer exist.
timeline.quote: Mayael rallied her army of elves and gargantuans and try to hold borders that no longer existed.

citation.text: "The Soul of the World". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jan 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Naya's elves, Nacatl and behemoths march to war with Bant and Jund, guided by Mayael's visions of Progenitus.
timeline.quote: Guided by the visions of the elvish prophet Mayael, the elves, the Nacatl, and the earthshaking behemoths of Naya march to war with its new neighbors.

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bant's Blessed face Esper's metallic horrors and Naya's encroaching jungle, and the knight-captains find their ceremonial combat naive as massed armies fight.
timeline.quote: The angels seem powerless to enforce Bant's cherished law, and soldiers fall by the hundreds.

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jund's goblins and landwurms spill into the neighboring shards and hellkites find new threats to their dominion.
timeline.quote: The goblin tribes of Jund began to explore the new lands

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The bones of Jund's dead resurface in Naya, poisoning the jungle and the sunseeders' crops.
timeline.quote: The bones of Jund's dead resurfaced in Naya, poisoning the jungle and killing the sunseeders' crops.

citation.text: Corrupted Roots (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Egbol stares in wonder at Naya's landscape, seeing only things to eat and steal.
timeline.quote: Egbol stared in wonder at Naya's landscape.

citation.text: Goblin Outlander (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: When the shards merge, Mayael finds herself general of Naya's mightiest army.
timeline.quote: When the shards merged, Mayael found herself the general of Naya's mightiest army.

citation.text: Meglonoth (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Plowbeasts of Naya escape their harnesses and feed on the fields of Eos and Valeron.
timeline.quote: Plowbeasts of Naya escaped their harnesses in droves

citation.text: Vagrant Plowbeasts (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ajani threatens Tenoch at a cliff and falls, vanishing into the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: he vanished into the Blind Eternities

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Alara unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani absorbs the last of the Maelstrom and banishes Bolas from Alara.
timeline.quote: he called up an effigy of Bolas's soul and used it to banish Bolas from Alara

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Alara unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ajani declines to become Kha and leaves Naya, entrusting Zaliki.
timeline.quote: chose to leave Naya instead, entrusting Zaliki with the responsibilities of being the Kha

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Alara unbroken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Conflux black and blue mana flood Naya, and Progenitus awakens.
timeline.quote: Naya is now flooded with all five colors and Progenitus has awoken, roving the lands for inscrutable purposes.

citation.text: "Naya", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Naya becomes part of New Alara as the shards connect.
timeline.quote: Naya's borders continued to run into the borders of Jund and Bant until it had completely connected to the other five shards, becoming part of New Alara.

citation.text: "Naya", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bant barely touches black and red mana at the Conflux, yet Paragon of the Amesha uses it.
timeline.quote: At the time of the Conflux, Bant has barely come in contact with black mana (from Esper) and red mana (from Naya)

citation.text: "Incursion Zones". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The knight flees away from Grixis into the lands that become Naya.
timeline.quote: Grixis was everywhere. So the knight fled in the other direction.

citation.text: "Circumnavigation". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: In Naya the knight sees white mana, never known in Jund, in the Nacatl and elves.
timeline.quote: He saw it in the fighting styles of the Nacatl lion-folk

citation.text: "Circumnavigation". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Naya victims cringe as lava from Jund is brought down on their village.
timeline.quote: That's magical lava brought down on your little Naya village all the way from the encroaching plane of Jund

citation.text: "Magic Art Tropes". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Some Naya Nacatl join Bant and help defend the stone walls recently raised to keep Jund, Grixis and Esper out of Bant and Naya.
timeline.quote: helping defend the stone walls recently erected to keep Jund, Grixis, and Esper from encroaching on the sunnier lands of Bant and Naya

citation.text: "Choices in the New Alara". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Broka jokes that a spellbreaker behemoth ate a bunch of wizards.
timeline.quote: I think it just ate a bunch of wizards.

citation.text: Spellbreaker Behemoth (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Godtrackers find new pantheons of beast-gods beyond Naya's borders.
timeline.quote: Godtrackers found new pantheons of beast-gods beyond Naya's borders.

citation.text: Sages of the Anima (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Knight-captains recruit Nayan falcons as couriers after many aven die scouting the fronts.
timeline.quote: So many aven had died scouting the distant fronts that the knight-captains recruited Nayan falcons as couriers.

citation.text: Messenger Falcons (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After Alara was reborn, vedalken heretics from Esper reject etherium for nature in the jungles of Naya.
timeline.quote: they rejected the cold clutch of etherium in favor of the warm embrace of nature

citation.text: "Vedalken", section "Nayan Vedalken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Naya elves journey through the rotting land of Grixis, and Grixis undead assault a Bant stronghold, as examples of Alara Reborn's fusion of shards.
timeline.quote: Zealous Persecution shows Grixis undead assaulting a Bant stronghold.

citation.text: "Reality Check". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A Jund wurm makes itself at home in Naya, eating elves and leonin in place of goblins and viashino.
timeline.quote: A Jund wurm makes itself at home in the lush, green jungles and stone ruins of Naya.

citation.text: "Reality Check". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ranalus renounces Esper and the Filigree Texts while undercover in the jungles of Naya.
timeline.quote: she made the decision to renounce Esper and to repudiate the principles of the Filigree Texts

citation.text: "Gold Records". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ranalus extracts all her etherium while a coatl offers its regenerative powers.
timeline.quote: she extracted every thread and joint of etherium from her body

citation.text: "Gold Records". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Dollun Spinebreaker's Eleventh Legion is slaughtered in Naya.
timeline.quote: Dollun saw his men slain by the hundreds on a long and chaotic campaign into Naya

citation.text: "Gold Records". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Conflux breaks Banath'thur's bindings and he enslaves the Vithians and a Nacatl pride.
timeline.quote: Banath'thur turned the Vithians and the nearby Nacatl pride into his own personal minions

citation.text: "Gold Records". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Alara's five shards converge into one plane flowing with all five colors of mana.
timeline.quote: But now they have converged into one, and the rejoined plane flows with all five colors of mana once more.

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As the boundaries dissolve, cultures clash and wars break out between the shards.
timeline.quote: As the boundaries between the shards dissolve, cultures clash and wars ensue.

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Naya's forces march out of the jungle searching for answers to the Anima's visions, and Bant's armies fight the horrors crossing their borders.
timeline.quote: And the armies of Bant clash with the horrors swarming over their borders, defending their homeland in the name of their guardian angels.

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Marisi forms the Claws of Marisi, an anti-civilization group.
timeline.quote: a young Nacatl named Marisi formed an anti-civilization group known as the Claws of Marisi

citation.text: "Coil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Claws of Marisi and the Pride of Judges fight for dominance in the streets.
timeline.quote: Soon there was open warfare in the streets as the Claws of Marisi and the Pride of Judges fought for dominance.

citation.text: "Coil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Marisi's revolutionaries triumph and the Coil is broken.
timeline.quote: In the end, Marisi's revolutionaries triumphed and the Coil was broken.

citation.text: "Coil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Once war between the shards begins, Dollun sees his men slain in a chaotic campaign into Naya, shattering his sense of propriety and honor.
timeline.quote: This experience shattered Dollun's sense of propriety and honor

citation.text: "Dollun Spinebreaker", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hasal, Elishta and Maklo flee a gargantuan and run past Domri Rade, freshly planeswalked.
timeline.quote: They ran past Domri Rade , freshly planeswalked for the first time

citation.text: "Hasal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An elf pulls Domri into a cave until the gargantuan passes.
timeline.quote: pulled him into a dark cave until the gargantuan had passed them by

citation.text: "Hasal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hasal questions Domri, who describes Ravnica and the Gruul.
timeline.quote: an entire world made of buildings

citation.text: "Hasal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Domri accidentally planeswalks away again, making the elves among the first to witness a planeswalk.
timeline.quote: Domri accidentally planeswalked away again

citation.text: "Hasal", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Keimon carries his wounded master toward the Maelstrom to deliver a spell capsule to Naya.
timeline.quote: They aimed to deliver a critical spell capsule to Naya

citation.text: "Keimon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Fifteen years before the Conflux, Progenitus begins to awaken in the Second Stirring.
timeline.quote: Progenitus began to awaken

citation.text: "Progenitus", section "The Second Stirring". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Although the Anima herself remains at the Sacellum, her druids roam Naya

citation.text: Druid of the Anima (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: "The One, The Only, Nicol Bolas". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Speaks as an authority on Naya's behemoths and guardians.
relations.quote: Do not mistake a behemoth's assistance for subservience.

citation.text: Sigiled Behemoth (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.note: The woolly thoctar is a creature native to Naya.

citation.text: "Our Path to Exile". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Mayael speaks of ancients treading the land.
relations.quote: See, the land itself raises an altar to the ascendancy of nature.

citation.text: Restore (Commander 2013, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: Elves believe the hydra-god Progenitus sleeps beneath Naya
